package dialog_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	dialoghttp "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/infrastructure/http/dialog"
)

func TestClientReadsBoundedTeacherRequestContext(t *testing.T) {
	request := validRequest()
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		require.Equal(t, http.MethodGet, r.Method)
		require.Equal(t, "/internal/v1/teacher-dialog/"+request.DialogID+"/request/"+request.SourceMessageID, r.URL.Path)
		require.Equal(t, request.PersonalTeacherID, r.URL.Query().Get("personal_teacher_id"))
		require.Equal(t, "12", r.URL.Query().Get("before"))
		require.Equal(t, "internal-token", r.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token"))
		writeContextResponse(t, w, request)
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client := dialoghttp.Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "internal-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}

	contextSnapshot, err := client.GetTeacherRequestContext(context.Background(), request, 12)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, request.SourceMessageID, contextSnapshot.Messages[len(contextSnapshot.Messages)-1].ID)
	require.Equal(t, "Почему тест падает?", contextSnapshot.Messages[len(contextSnapshot.Messages)-1].Body)
}

func TestClientReadsVersionedLessonOverviewSource(t *testing.T) {
	request := validRequest()
	request.ContextType = domain.LearningContextLesson
	request.LearningActionID = ""
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
		_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{
			"dialog_id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
			"student_id":"44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
			"personal_teacher_id":"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
			"context_type":"lesson","context_id":"66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666",
			"source_message_id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333","learning_action_id":null,
			"messages":[{
				"id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
				"dialog_id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222","author_type":"user","channel":"web",
				"sender_id":"44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444","personal_teacher_id":null,
				"learning_action_id":null,
				"lesson_context":{"schema":"lesson-message-context.v1","mode":"lesson_overview",
					"course_id":"aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa",
					"lesson_id":"66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666",
					"content_revision":"2026-08-30T10:00:00Z"},
				"reply_to_message_id":null,"body":"Объясни этот урок","links":[],"status":1,"version":1,
				"message_sequence":1,"last_event_sequence":2,"attachments":[],"edited_at":null,"deleted_at":null,
				"created_at":"2026-08-30T10:00:00Z","updated_at":"2026-08-30T10:00:00Z"
			}]
		}`))
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client := dialoghttp.Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "internal-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}

	contextSnapshot, err := client.GetTeacherRequestContext(context.Background(), request, 12)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	lesson := contextSnapshot.Messages[0].LessonContext
	require.NotNil(t, lesson)
	require.Equal(t, domain.LessonMessageContextSchemaVersion, lesson.Schema)
	require.Equal(t, domain.LessonMessageModeOverview, lesson.Mode)
	require.Equal(t, "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa", lesson.CourseID)
}

func TestClientEnsuresTeacherDialogBinding(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		require.Equal(t, http.MethodPut, r.Method)
		require.Equal(t, "/internal/v1/teacher-dialog/ensure", r.URL.Path)
		var body map[string]any
		require.NoError(t, json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&body))
		require.Equal(t, "platform", body["space_key"])
		require.Equal(t, "lesson", body["context_type"])
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated)
		_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{
			"id":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111","space_id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
			"type":3,"status":1,"student_id":"44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
			"personal_teacher_id":"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555","context_type":"lesson",
			"context_id":"66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666","version":1,"member_count":1,
			"message_count":0,"max_message_sequence":0,"max_event_sequence":1,"last_message_id":null,
			"last_message_at":null,"current_member":{},"members":[],
			"created_at":"2026-08-31T10:00:00Z","updated_at":"2026-08-31T10:00:00Z"
		}`))
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client := dialoghttp.Client{
		BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "internal-token", SpaceKey: "platform", HTTPClient: server.Client(),
	}

	binding, err := client.EnsureTeacherDialog(
		context.Background(), "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", domain.LearningContextLesson,
		"66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666",
	)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, binding.Created)
	require.Equal(t, domain.LearningContextLesson, binding.ContextType)
}

func TestClientMaterializesCanonicalStudentTurnWithExactNestedContract(t *testing.T) {
	binding := domain.TeacherDialogBinding{ID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", StudentID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", PersonalTeacherID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", ContextType: domain.LearningContextGeneral}
	input := domain.CanonicalStudentTurnMaterialization{
		Schema: domain.CanonicalStudentTurnMaterializationSchema, DialogID: binding.ID, StudentID: binding.StudentID, PersonalTeacherID: binding.PersonalTeacherID,
		ActionReceiptID: "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777", CanonicalMessageCommandID: "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888",
		CorrelationID: "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777", CausationID: "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777",
		SourceMessageID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", SourceMessageVersion: 3, BlockID: "onboarding.direction.d0.v1", ActionID: "direction.backend",
		SourceUIDigest: domain.CanonicalSourceUIDigest([]byte(`{"schema":"assistant-ui.v1"}`)), Body: "I choose: Backend",
	}
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		require.Equal(t, http.MethodPost, r.Method)
		require.Equal(t, "/internal/v1/teacher-dialog/"+binding.ID+"/canonical-student-turn", r.URL.Path)
		require.Equal(t, "internal-token", r.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token"))
		var body map[string]any
		require.NoError(t, json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&body))
		require.Contains(t, body, "identity")
		require.Equal(t, "I choose: Backend", body["canonical_body"])
		require.NotContains(t, body, "body")
		identity := body["identity"].(map[string]any)
		require.Equal(t, "canonical-student-turn-identity.v1", identity["schema"])
		require.Equal(t, input.ActionReceiptID, identity["action_receipt_id"])
		require.Equal(t, input.CanonicalMessageCommandID, identity["canonical_message_command_id"])
		require.NotContains(t, identity, "source_ui_digest")
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated)
		_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{"id":"99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999","dialog_id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222","author_type":"user","channel":"web","sender_id":"44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444","personal_teacher_id":null,"learning_action_id":null,"reply_to_message_id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333","body":"I choose: Backend","links":[],"status":1,"version":1,"message_sequence":2,"last_event_sequence":2,"attachments":[],"edited_at":null,"deleted_at":null,"created_at":"2026-09-01T10:00:00Z","updated_at":"2026-09-01T10:00:00Z"}`))
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client := dialoghttp.Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "internal-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	message, err := client.MaterializeCanonicalStudentTurn(context.Background(), input)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999", message.ID)
	require.Equal(t, domain.DialogMessageAuthorUser, message.AuthorType)
}

func TestClientAppendsTeacherResponseIdempotently(t *testing.T) {
	request := validRequest()
	idempotencyKey := "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888"
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		require.Equal(t, http.MethodPost, r.Method)
		var body map[string]any
		require.NoError(t, json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&body))
		require.Equal(t, request.PersonalTeacherID, body["personal_teacher_id"])
		require.Equal(t, request.SourceMessageID, body["source_message_id"])
		require.Equal(t, idempotencyKey, body["idempotency_key"])
		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated)
		_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{
			"id":"99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999",
			"dialog_id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
			"author_type":"personal_teacher",
			"channel":"web",
			"sender_id":null,
			"personal_teacher_id":"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
			"learning_action_id":"77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777",
			"reply_to_message_id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
			"body":"Проверь условие цикла.","links":[],"status":1,"version":1,
			"message_sequence":2,"last_event_sequence":3,"attachments":[],
			"edited_at":null,"deleted_at":null,
			"created_at":"2026-08-30T10:01:00Z","updated_at":"2026-08-30T10:01:00Z"
		}`))
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client := dialoghttp.Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "internal-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}

	message, err := client.AppendTeacherResponse(context.Background(), request, idempotencyKey, "Проверь условие цикла.")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, domain.DialogMessageAuthorPersonalTeacher, message.AuthorType)
	require.Equal(t, request.SourceMessageID, message.ReplyToMessageID)
}

func TestClientAppendsProactiveOfferToGeneralTeacherDialog(t *testing.T) {
	binding := domain.TeacherDialogBinding{
		ID:                "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		StudentID:         "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		PersonalTeacherID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
		ContextType:       domain.LearningContextGeneral,
	}
	idempotencyKey := "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888"
	body := "Похоже, ты зациклился. Хочешь небольшую подсказку?"
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		require.Equal(t, http.MethodPost, r.Method)
		require.Equal(t, "/internal/v1/teacher-dialog/"+binding.ID+"/proactive-message", r.URL.Path)
		require.Equal(t, "internal-token", r.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token"))
		var request map[string]any
		require.NoError(t, json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&request))
		require.Equal(t, binding.PersonalTeacherID, request["personal_teacher_id"])
		require.Equal(t, idempotencyKey, request["idempotency_key"])
		require.Equal(t, body, request["body"])
		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated)
		_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{
			"id":"99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999",
			"dialog_id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
			"author_type":"personal_teacher","sender_id":null,
			"channel":"web",
			"personal_teacher_id":"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
			"learning_action_id":null,"lesson_context":null,"reply_to_message_id":null,
			"body":"Похоже, ты зациклился. Хочешь небольшую подсказку?",
			"links":[],"status":1,"version":1,"message_sequence":2,
			"last_event_sequence":3,"attachments":[],"edited_at":null,"deleted_at":null,
			"created_at":"2026-08-31T18:01:00Z","updated_at":"2026-08-31T18:01:00Z"
		}`))
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client := dialoghttp.Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "internal-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}

	message, err := client.AppendTeacherProactive(context.Background(), binding, idempotencyKey, body)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, binding.ID, message.DialogID)
	require.Empty(t, message.ReplyToMessageID)
	require.Empty(t, message.LearningActionID)
}

func TestClientReadsStrictAssistantUISourceAndAppendsExactEnvelope(t *testing.T) {
	binding := domain.TeacherDialogBinding{ID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", StudentID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", PersonalTeacherID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", ContextType: domain.LearningContextGeneral}
	messageID, key := "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999", "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888"
	body, assistantUI, err := domain.BuildTeacherOnboardingPrompt(domain.OnboardingStepDirection, "ru")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	var persistedAssistantUIValue any
	require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(assistantUI, &persistedAssistantUIValue))
	persistedAssistantUI, err := json.Marshal(persistedAssistantUIValue)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotEqual(t, string(assistantUI), string(persistedAssistantUI))
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		require.Equal(t, "internal-token", r.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token"))
		switch r.URL.Path {
		case "/internal/v1/teacher-dialog/" + binding.ID + "/assistant-ui-source":
			var request map[string]any
			require.NoError(t, json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&request))
			require.Equal(t, binding.StudentID, request["student_id"])
			require.Equal(t, binding.PersonalTeacherID, request["personal_teacher_id"])
			require.Equal(t, messageID, request["message_id"])
			_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{"schema":"dialog-assistant-ui-source.v1","dialog_id":"` + binding.ID + `","student_id":"` + binding.StudentID + `","personal_teacher_id":"` + binding.PersonalTeacherID + `","context_type":"general_teacher","message_id":"` + messageID + `","message_sequence":4,"message_version":1,"assistant_ui":` + string(persistedAssistantUI) + `}`))
		case "/internal/v1/teacher-dialog/" + binding.ID + "/proactive-message":
			var request map[string]json.RawMessage
			require.NoError(t, json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&request))
			require.JSONEq(t, string(assistantUI), string(request["assistant_ui"]))
			require.JSONEq(t, `"`+body+`"`, string(request["body"]))
			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated)
			_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{"id":"` + messageID + `","dialog_id":"` + binding.ID + `","author_type":"personal_teacher","channel":"web","sender_id":null,"personal_teacher_id":"` + binding.PersonalTeacherID + `","learning_action_id":null,"lesson_context":null,"assistant_ui":` + string(persistedAssistantUI) + `,"reply_to_message_id":null,"body":` + string(request["body"]) + `,"links":[],"status":1,"version":1,"message_sequence":4,"last_event_sequence":4,"attachments":[],"edited_at":null,"deleted_at":null,"created_at":"2026-09-05T08:00:00Z","updated_at":"2026-09-05T08:00:00Z"}`))
		default:
			t.Fatalf("unexpected path %s", r.URL.Path)
		}
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client := dialoghttp.Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "internal-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	message, err := client.AppendTeacherStructuredProactive(context.Background(), binding, key, body, assistantUI)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.JSONEq(t, string(assistantUI), string(message.AssistantUI))
	source, err := client.GetAssistantUISource(context.Background(), binding, messageID)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, 1, source.MessageVersion)
	require.JSONEq(t, string(assistantUI), string(source.AssistantUI))
}

func TestClientAppendsTelegramStudentMessageToGeneralDialog(t *testing.T) {
	binding := domain.TeacherDialogBinding{
		ID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", StudentID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		PersonalTeacherID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", ContextType: domain.LearningContextGeneral,
	}
	key := "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888"
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		require.Equal(t, "/internal/v1/teacher-dialog/"+binding.ID+"/student-channel-message", r.URL.Path)
		var request map[string]any
		require.NoError(t, json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&request))
		require.Equal(t, binding.StudentID, request["student_id"])
		require.Equal(t, "telegram", request["channel"])
		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated)
		_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{
			"id":"99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999","dialog_id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
			"author_type":"user","channel":"telegram","sender_id":"44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
			"personal_teacher_id":null,"learning_action_id":null,"lesson_context":null,"reply_to_message_id":null,
			"body":"Привет","links":[],"status":1,"version":1,"message_sequence":1,"last_event_sequence":1,
			"attachments":[],"edited_at":null,"deleted_at":null,
			"created_at":"2026-09-01T10:00:00Z","updated_at":"2026-09-01T10:00:00Z"}`))
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client := dialoghttp.Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "internal-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	message, err := client.AppendStudentChannelMessage(context.Background(), binding, key, domain.DialogMessageChannelTelegram, "Привет")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, domain.DialogMessageChannelTelegram, message.Channel)
}

func TestClientFailsClosedOnDrift(t *testing.T) {
	request := validRequest()
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
		_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{"unexpected":true}`))
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client := dialoghttp.Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "internal-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	_, err := client.GetTeacherRequestContext(context.Background(), request, 12)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrDialogStateUnavailable)
}

func TestClientFailsClosedOnSourceSequenceDrift(t *testing.T) {
	request := validRequest()
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
		response := contextResponseJSON()
		_, _ = w.Write([]byte(strings.Replace(response, `"message_sequence":1`, `"message_sequence":9`, 1)))
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client := dialoghttp.Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "internal-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	_, err := client.GetTeacherRequestContext(context.Background(), request, 12)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrDialogStateUnavailable)
}

func validRequest() domain.DialogTeacherRequest {
	request, err := domain.NewDialogTeacherRequest(domain.DialogTeacherRequest{
		EventID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", DialogID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		EventSequence: 2, SourceMessageID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", SourceSequence: 1,
		StudentID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", PersonalTeacherID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
		ContextType: domain.LearningContextPracticeTask, ContextID: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666",
		LearningActionID: "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777", OccurredAt: time.Date(2026, 8, 30, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
	})
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	return request
}

func writeContextResponse(t *testing.T, w http.ResponseWriter, request domain.DialogTeacherRequest) {
	t.Helper()
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_, err := w.Write([]byte(contextResponseJSON()))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	_ = request
}

func contextResponseJSON() string {
	return `{
		"dialog_id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		"student_id":"44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		"personal_teacher_id":"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
		"context_type":"practice_task",
		"context_id":"66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666",
		"source_message_id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		"learning_action_id":"77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777",
		"messages":[{
			"id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
			"dialog_id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
			"author_type":"user",
			"channel":"web",
			"sender_id":"44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
			"learning_action_id":"77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777",
			"reply_to_message_id":null,"body":"Почему тест падает?","links":[],
			"status":1,"version":1,"message_sequence":1,"last_event_sequence":2,
			"attachments":[],"edited_at":null,"deleted_at":null,
			"created_at":"2026-08-30T10:00:00Z","updated_at":"2026-08-30T10:00:00Z"
		}]
	}`
}
